item.valyrainsteel.dark_sister.lore: Forged slender for a warrior queen and wielded by a rogue prince, this dark steel thirsts for the blood of dragons.
item.valyrainsteel.dark_sister.active: Holding down charges a fiery dash that launches the user forward and deals damage to enemies caught in the path
item.valyrainsteel.dark_sister.passive: Every consecutive hit increases critical strike chance by 5%. (Max 50%) (Critical Strike 2x Damage)
item.valyrainsteel.catspaw_dagger.lore: Forged in ancient Valyria and bathed in royal blood, this blade carries the prophecy of kings and the doom of winter.
item.valyrainsteel.catspaw_dagger.active: Throw a spectral copy of the dagger.
item.valyrainsteel.calamity.lore: Forged in the Freehold before the Doom, Calamity was whispered to have split mountains and silenced forests beneath a sky of black thunder.
item.valyrainsteel.calamity.active: Hurl the axe to unleash a storm of lightning where it lands.
item.valyrainsteel.calamity.passive: Strike the base of a tree to fell it in a single blow.
